description: Mindola helps you turn approved information about yourself, your work, or your business into a shareable Q&A page. Create a reviewable AI lens that can answer questions, explain what you do, guide visitors to the right next step, and preserve useful context. You stay in control of what is included, and nothing is created until you approve it.
